dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Sisi is my cat's name. I was just asking it a question.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: But this fellow's been capricious recently and doesn't respond no matter how much I call.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Never mind, no need to worry. They are probably looking for trouble with Ouo again.

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: I'd better ask my daughter to help you with check-in. Sareh... Sareh, are you there?
